summary: Shows a debugger session: print the result and task.args, change task.args['data'] to use the correct variable, and redo the task successfully.
questions: How do I change a task's arguments inside the debugger and retry?
How do I see the error result in the Ansible debugger?

answer_card.title: Fixing a task in the debugger
answer_card.answer_md:
```
(debug)> p result._result        # see the error
(debug)> p task.args
{u'data': u'{{ wrong_var }}'}
(debug)> task.args['data'] = '{{ var1 }}'
(debug)> redo
ok: [192.0.2.10]
```
